data.headline: Avoid Dyson V8 Cyclone; buy Bosch BSS71125AH instead

reasons.text: Consumer Reports removed the Dyson V8 from its recommended list due to poor reliability; multiple V-series models fail after 3–4 years.
Multiple user failure reports: switch failure after 3 years, battery degradation, and brush bar issues with long hair.
Estimated lifetime cost is high: mid-life only 2.77 years, €111.69/year plus consumables, versus Bosch BSS71125AH at €70.08/year.
Bosch BSS71125AH costs €179.99, has a 6-year mid-life estimate, no failure reports, and 4.55 stars from 29 reviews.
Dyson V8 Cyclone has 30 offers and 4.54 stars from only 41 reviews, with no independent tests to offset reliability concerns.
